summary_md: Today’s batch cuts across industrials, energy, and utilities, with operational turnarounds and strategic pivots testing management credibility. Two clear momentum stories stand out: **BEEP**’s parking portfolio inflection is driving a short-squeeze dynamic and institutional buying as its volume-first strategy takes hold, while **DGXX**’s on-schedule AI data center buildout is already generating GPU-as-a-Service revenue on NVIDIA hardware—without balance-sheet strain. On the opposite end, **STRS** is wrestling with steeply discounted Bitcoin-linked preferred shares, an unusual priority management calls its top task. Insider buying surfaces as a recurring confidence signal at **HNRG**, **JCTC**, and **OPAL**, and tariff or regulatory crosscurrents shape the outlook for **UFI** and **RGCO**. Restructuring narratives at **CULP**, **EML**, and **JCTC** hinge on proving cost-cutting and portfolio reshaping can convert to durable earnings, while **NTRP**’s pivot to travel media faces sharp skepticism after a post-earnings stock drop.
